The driver's hands appear to merge slightly with the steering wheel spokes. The fingers lack clear definition and seem to blend into the black plastic of the wheel, indicating a boundary failure.

The vertical pillars supporting the roof show slight inconsistency in thickness and alignment. The rear right pillar seems to taper oddly and doesn't align perfectly with the roofline perspective.
